title: Remedial Potion
summary: Drink or splash to cure multiple debilitating conditions.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action, single use. Cures Blinded, Diseased, Poisoned and Paralyzed group conditions, Colour Spray and Silenced.
fields.Throw: Action up to 60 ft. Applies those removals to all creatures within 3 ft. Hazardous areas can immediately reapply a cured condition.
fields.Alchemy: Extract three Xorn Scales into Salts of Xorn Scales, then add any Suspension.
fields.Acquisition: Sold by various traders, including Lady Esther.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
